chapter: The district underworld and street musicians
title: Morphodites dressed as women in the district
summary: Dawson explains that men dressed as women at night around the Big 25.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: And did they have many jockeys around there?
Oh, well, down there, yeah, they had, they said, bum around there but they had more Morphets around there and they had men, uh, Morphets, used to dress up like women.
I mean jockeys that rode horses.
Oh, no, yeah, they had a few of them, round there. Yeah. Yeah, they had some.
And the Morphets dressed up like women.
Like women at night, man, they'd be all dressed up at the... Women clothes on and earrings and all. How did you tell the difference?
